verdict.rationale: The SDK documents that it writes session transcripts to disk automatically, and its SessionStore adapter can mirror those transcripts to a user-owned object store, key-value store or database. That gives some first-party data portability for session history. The evidence never states the file format, does not say these are 'all' of a user's data, and does not describe an export-and-leave workflow. Missing for 10: documented open/standard export format, a complete all-data export, an explicit offboarding/export workflow, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: The SDK writes it to disk automatically so you can return to it later.
